current.summary: I’m a TA for IDS 706: Data Engineering Systems. I hold weekly office hours, help with grading, and lead demonstrations on Python project setup, GitHub Actions, Docker, and database design. The course also covers SQL, cloud ETL, Airflow, PySpark, and Kafka.

current.title: Graduate Data Science Intern
current.summary: I spent the summer of 2026 at Liberty Mutual in Boston. My project combined features from claim photos with a structured-data score in a LightGBM model to improve early total-loss detection. I used Optuna to tune the model and worked on validation that avoided data leakage. Ablation studies and SHAP analyses helped me check where the photo features added useful information and understand the model’s limits.
